consumer: The frontend status panel that reads the avatar's stamina and pain scalars and SHOWS them to the player; it asks 'what number do I render in this field', not a yes/no.
scope: not applicable - the avatar's own scalar status attributes (stamina, pain), not an item reach or map region
decisive_source: src/arcopolis_export.cpp::write_avatar (scalars) - its body writes ctx.u.get_stamina() and ctx.u.get_pain() straight from the engine getters into the snapshot JSON the panel renders
divergence: Avatar sprints until the engine's get_stamina() drops from 10000 to 3000 (or steps on a trap raising get_pain() to 40); a wrong answer that reports a stale or zero value instead of 3000/40 is exposed against the live getter the GUI displays.
